SUMMARY: Daily Drilling Report #142 for Well Nahorkatiya-093 documenting severe
15.4 bbl/hr mud losses at 3,428 m in Barail Coal-Shale and successful
stabilization using 25 bbl Nut-Plug/Mica/CaCO3 LCM pill. VERBATIM OPERATIONAL LOG:
08: :00 HRS: Drilling /2" hole in Barail Coal-Shale from 3,418 m to 3,428
m with 1.24 sg KCl-Polymer mud. At 3,428 m, encountered sudden drilling break (ROP
jumped from 18.2 to 27.4 m/hr) followed by 180 psi SPP drop and dynamic mud loss
of 15.4 bbl/hr into micro-cleated coal fractures. Reduced flow rate from 2,150 LPM
to 1,750 LPM. Spotted 25 bbl LCM pill (15 ppb Medium Nut-Plug + 10 ppb Coarse
Flake Mica + 8 ppb Sized CaCO3 150-micron) across 3, ,448 m. Soaked for 45
mins under 150 psi squeeze pressure. Full returns re-established; dynamic seepage
<0.8 bbl/hr.
